'''Jai Quallo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|Beast master]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. A member of the [[Dust Vipers]] gang operating on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in [[3630 BBY]] he was guarding the entrance to the gang's compound near [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] when [[Eternal Alliance]] ambushed it, looking to reclaim stolen security codes of the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]]. Jai Quallo and his beasts fought the intruders, but were overwhelmed and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jai Quallo appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a boss during the "Done and Dusted" Uprising.
